messages:
inc-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Orpheus (enterprise, VPC-dedicated eu-west-2) crossing p99 latency SLO for text.generate on /v1/generate — p99 ~ 4.2s, p95 ~ 1.1s. Impacting 10% of requests. Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/orgeu2/orpheus
backoff_oncall: acknowledging, paging SRE + eng. I'll join now.
mira: on it, fetching current task queues and pool utilization. assigning `trace-id: orph-4512`
dan: adding product/CS to thread — @cs-ops for customer comms (Orpheus)
anita: seeing error spikes in worker logs, lots of `KV cache miss` warnings followed by GC pauses on some nodes.
jonas: confirmed spikes align with a recent model variant roll (model:v2b) that went live 23:45 UTC. Can we rollback?
li: metrics: routing queue depth up 6x on tenant shard 7, cpu on pool-gpu-07 at 92%. Warm spares (eu-west-3) healthy.
mira: quick mitigation idea — apply tenant isolation on shard 7 (limit concurrent connections) + route excess to warm spare region. prepping policy changes.
backoff_oncall: execute isolation, coordinate with routing. I'll take handoff once mitigation applied.
jonas: mira, steps?
mira: apply ACL: `redwood tenant isolate --tenant orpheus --shard 7 --concurrency 50` ; then `routing set-precedence orpheus eu-west-3 0.2` (20% spillover). Doing dry run now.
deploy-bot: :hammer_and_wrench: running `tenant isolate` on pool-gpu-07 (job id: 0a9f). ETA ~20s.
inc-bot: Paging sequence: @backoff_oncall -> @mira -> @jonas -> @li (severity: high)
cs-ops: copying customer success escalation template, preparing initial note: "We are investigating increased latency affecting a subset of requests. Dedicated team paged and mitigation in progress."
dan: also add note: "no data exfiltration, only performance impact" — customer asked for clarity on impact scope.
mira: isolation applied, spillover to eu-west-3 at 20% enabled. Monitoring.
li: immediate drop in queue depth by ~40% on shard 7, p99 trending down to 2.1s. Still above SLO but improving.
jonas: rolling back model:v2b flagged as risky — can we route Orpheus to model:v2a (previous) without downtime?
mira: yes, model variant fallback supported at routing layer: `routing set-model orpheus model:v2a` — I'll flip 30% now, then 100% if stable.
backoff_oncall: proceed with staged fallback. Notify if any error increases.
deploy-bot: :rocket: routing change applied (change-id: r-774).
li: after fallback 30% -> p99 down to 1.3s, p95 0.9s. CPU on pool-gpu-07 68%.
anita: logs show some worker OOMs earlier; GC tuning + cache sizing will be follow-up. Not seeing errors from eu-west-3.
cs-ops: sent update to Orpheus contact (Grace) at 23:59 UTC with mitigation summary and ETA for full recovery.
dan: great. Can SRE confirm customer impact window and whether SLA credit needed?
backoff_oncall: estimate impact window ~23:43–00:02 UTC (20m). Flag for billing review.
mira: promoting staged fallback to 100% to model:v2a now.
deploy-bot: routing model promotion complete.
li: p99 stabilized ~0.9s. All core metrics within SLO. Queue depth normalized.
jonas: leaving a note to block future auto-rollouts during tenant surge windows — we should gate model rollouts by shard utilization.
anita: creating incident ticket INC-451234 for postmortem. Add owners: mira (lead), anita (SRE notes), jonas (product).
backoff_oncall: handing off to follow-up oncall (mira) for postmortem and remediation. I'll mark page resolved.
inc-bot: Incident update: RESOLVED — Orpheus p99 latency breach contained. Root cause: variant roll + tenant-specific request pattern causing KV cache pressure and worker GC. Next steps: postmortem, GC tuning, rollout gating.
cs-ops: I'll coordinate customer debrief + share timeline and planned mitigations.
dan: thx team. Postmortem owner Mira — due EOD tomorrow.
mira: copying short timeline into ticket and will include mitigation commands and metrics.
jonas: +1 for automated canary hold when shard queue > threshold.
anita: will propose config changes and a short maintenance patch for cache sizing.
